_readme: Add or edit products below. Each product needs: id (unique, no spaces), name, images (3-5 photo paths work best, any number is fine), mrp (original price), price (discounted price). Optional: description, details (bullet list), category, badge, featured (true = shown on the home page), inStock (false = shows Sold out). Put photos in images/shop/. These 6 items are SAMPLES — replace them with real products.
